description: Verify two scientific claims against real abstracts: one is supported, one is contradicted, and one paper is unrelated. Cite the evidence for each verdict.
task_prompt:
Two claims are under review.
Claim 1: Alirocumab treatment reduces apo(a) fractional clearance rate.
Claim 2: Polymeal nutrition reduces cardiovascular mortality.
Using the papers in documents/, decide for each claim whether the evidence supports or contradicts it. Write each verdict on its own line as 'Claim N: SUPPORTED' or 'Claim N: CONTRADICTED'. For each verdict, cite the paper and the specific result behind it.

rationale: For men, taking the Polymeal daily represented an increase in total life expectancy of 6.6 years, an increase in life expectancy free from cardiovascular disease of 9.0 years, and a decrease in life expectancy with cardiovascular disease of 2.4 years.
CONCLUSION The Polymeal promises to be an effective, non-pharmacological, safe, cheap, and tasty alternative to reduce cardiovascular morbidity and increase life expectancy in the general population.

seeds.text: Alirocumab treatment reduces apo(a) fractional clearance rate.
rationale: RESULTS Alirocumab reduced ultracentrifugally isolated LDL-C by 55.1%, LDL-apoB by 56.3%, and plasma Lp(a) by 18.7%.
The fall in LDL-apoB was caused by an 80.4% increase in LDL-apoB FCR and a 23.9% reduction in LDL-apoB PR.
The FCR of apo(a) tended to increase (24.6%) without any change in apo(a) PR.
CONCLUSIONS Alirocumab decreased LDL-C and LDL-apoB by increasing IDL- and LDL-apoB FCRs and decreasing LDL-apoB PR.
The increase in apo(a) FCR during alirocumab treatment suggests that increased LDL receptors may also play a role in the reduction of plasma Lp(a).
